items.markdown:
![Website Design | Design Free One-Page Websites with Canva](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-bd43523c090c:4)
Website design is `the process of planning, structuring, and creating the visual appearance, user interface (UI), and user experience (UX) of a web page`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_design)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/)

### Core Elements of Web Design

- **Content:** Text, headers, and media (images, videos) that deliver your message.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/)
- **Layout:** The structural arrangement of elements on the screen, often using wireframes and grids.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XIwbuEtMIag)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/)
- **Visual Style:** Color palettes, contrast, and typography hierarchy that match your brand identity.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pbhLsV-Dyho)
- **Navigation:** Menus and link structures that help users find information quickly.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/)
- **Functionality:** Fast loading speeds and mobile-first responsiveness across all devices.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/)

### Popular Website Builders & Tools

- **No-Code Platforms:** You can build and launch a site visually using builders like [Wix](https://www.wix.com/website/design), [Squarespace](https://www.squarespace.com/website-design) , or the [Canva Website Builder](https://www.canva.com/website-builder/).[[1]](https://www.wix.com/website/design)[[2]](https://www.squarespace.com/website-design)[[3]](https://www.canva.com/website-builder/)
- **Design & Prototyping:** Designers map out interfaces using tools like [Figma](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-web-design/) before development.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j6Ule7GXaRs)
- **Inspiration Galleries:** You can browse layout ideas on [Siteinspire](https://www.siteinspire.com/).[[1]](https://www.siteinspire.com/)
